evals.prompt: Analyze my completed NEL run from supplied local artifacts. Do not launch jobs or connect to external services.
evals.expected_output: Inspects artifacts and validates results before reporting scores.
assertions: Uses supplied artifacts without assuming cluster access

evals.prompt: Plan how to inspect and resume failed NEL invocation abc123; do not run commands.
evals.expected_output: Inspects invocation state and failure before choosing resume.
assertions: Uses NEL info/status to plan diagnosis
Does not claim a resumed run passed

evals.prompt: Create a new NEL config only; do not execute it.
assertions: Does not run or resume evaluations

evals.prompt: Only modelopt-launching-evals is installed in an isolated catalog directory. Reuse an existing patched ModelOpt checkout at ./Model-Optimizer. Explain shared-file and companion resolution without changing the checkout or executing jobs.
evals.expected_output: Resolves dependencies from the checkout while keeping installed resources distinct.
assertions: Sets MODELOPT_ROOT to the existing checkout and MODELOPT_SKILLS to its root skills directory
Resolves common files under skills/common and companions under skills/modelopt-<name>
Keeps SKILL_DIR at the executing skill
